notes: Read the complete 370-line source hook line by line before editing and preserved every exported hook name, query key, request path, enabled gate, polling interval, staleTime, select transform, mutation payload, cache invalidation target, and toast fallback.

Source is non-visual API/type code; the native output uses the React Native-safe parity request client and Alert-backed mutation toast bridge, with no DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI imports.
Inlined the ExportJob type, safeArray guard, and query-broadcast shim because the native parity layer does not expose the web @/types/export, @/lib/safeArray, or @/lib/queryBroadcast aliases.

The browser-relative export download helper keeps the same /api/v1/export/jobs/:id/download API path but resolves through the native apiUrl helper so native callers receive a configured absolute API URL.
